excerpts.text: Different organisations are responsible for awarding the individual prizes; the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences awards the Prizes in Physics, Chemistry, and Economics; the Swedish Academy awards the Prize in Literature; the Karolinska Institute awards the Prize in Physiology or Medicine; and the Norwegian Nobel Committee awards the Prize in Peace.[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Nobel_laureates#cite_note-3) Each recipient receives a medal, a diploma and a monetary award that has varied throughout the years.[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Nobel_laureates#cite_note-NobelPrizeDescription-2) In 1901, the recipients of the first Nobel Prizes were given 150,782 [SEK](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Swedish_krona "Swedish krona"), equivalent to 10.8 million SEK in 2023.
